user.title: Second Brain
user.description: Persistent markdown knowledge store for your voice assistant. The chosen folder is used directly as the store - markdown files are created inside it. The LLM fields are the global model features use (e.g. the librarian); leave them empty if no feature needs one. Everything else - the librarian, MCP, Emby and the recorder tools - is added afterwards under Configure as separate features you can add or remove.

data.rules_chars: Max chars of rules in prompt
data.index_chars: Max chars of INDEX.md in prompt
data.note_chars: Max chars when reading a note
data.llm_api_key: Global LLM API key (optional, leave empty for local servers)

user.title: Self-improvement (reviews each turn)
user.description: Reviews every assist turn in the background and notes misfires and detours (a correct answer that took more tool calls than it needed). no_agent_selected.title: No conversation agent is using Second Brain
no_agent_selected.description:
Second Brain is set up, but no conversation agent has selected it, so the assistant has no access to your notes and cannot remember anything.

Open your conversation agent's options (for example Settings > Devices & services > your LLM integration) and tick **Second Brain** under the control/LLM API setting.

calendars_not_exposed.title: Calendars are not exposed to the assistant
calendars_not_exposed.description:
`get_calendar_events` can only read calendars that are exposed to Assist, and Home Assistant does not expose the calendar domain by default - so appointment questions currently return nothing.

Go to Settings > Voice assistants > Expose and expose the calendars you want the assistant to read.
